source: introspected from vllm.envs.environment_variables + Dynamo backend ArgGroups + vLLM Omni multimodal overlay

DYN_VLLM_EMBEDDING_TRANSFER_MODE.description: Worker embedding transfer mode: 'local' (default, local file system), 'nixl-write' (NIXL transfer with WRITE), or 'nixl-read' (NIXL transfer with READ).

DYN_TOOL_CALL_PARSER.description: Tool call parser name for the model.

DYN_REASONING_PARSER.description: Reasoning parser name for the model. If not specified, no reasoning parsing is performed.

VLLM_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for fetching images when serving multimodal models Default is 5 seconds

VLLM_VIDEO_FETCH_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for fetching videos when serving multimodal models Default is 30 seconds

VLLM_AUDIO_FETCH_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for fetching audio when serving multimodal models Default is 10 seconds

VLLM_MEDIA_FETCH_MAX_RETRIES.description: Maximum number of retries for fetching media (images, audio, video) from URLs. Each retry quadruples the timeout. Default is 3.

VLLM_MEDIA_LOADING_THREAD_COUNT.description: Max number of workers for the thread pool handling media bytes loading. Set to 1 to disable parallel processing. Default is 8

VLLM_MM_HASHER_ALGORITHM.description: Hash algorithm for multimodal content hashing. - "blake3": Default, fast cryptographic hash (not FIPS 140-3 compliant) - "sha256": FIPS 140-3 compliant, widely supported - "sha512": FIPS 140-3 compliant, faster on 64-bit systems Use sha256 or sha512 for FIPS compliance in government/enterprise deployments

VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING.description: If set, allow loading or unloading lora adapters in runtime,

VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST.description: IP address used for NIXL handshake between remote agents.

VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT.description: Port used for NIXL handshake between remote agents.

DYN_NAMESPACE.description: Dynamo namespace. If DYN_NAMESPACE_WORKER_SUFFIX is set, '-{suffix}' is appended to support multiple worker pools

DYN_ENDPOINT.description: Dynamo endpoint string in 'dyn://namespace.component.endpoint' format. Example: dyn://dynamo.backend.generate.

DYN_DISCOVERY_BACKEND.description: Discovery backend: kubernetes (K8s API), etcd (distributed KV), file (local filesystem), mem (in-memory). Etcd uses the ETCD_* env vars (e.g. ETCD_ENDPOINTS) for connection details. File uses root dir from env var DYN_FILE_KV or defaults to $TMPDIR/dynamo_store_kv.

DYN_REQUEST_PLANE.description: Determines how requests are distributed from routers to workers. 'tcp' is fastest.

DYN_CONNECTOR.description: [Deprecated for vLLM] Use --kv-transfer-config instead. For TRT-LLM, options: nixl, lmcache, kvbm, null, none.

DYN_DURABLE_KV_EVENTS.description: [Deprecated] Enable durable KV events using NATS JetStream instead of the local indexer. This option will be removed in a future release. The event-plane subscriber (local_indexer mode) is now the recommended path.

DYN_EXCLUDE_TOOLS_WHEN_TOOL_CHOICE_NONE.description: Exclude tool definitions from the chat template when tool_choice='none'. Prevents models from generating raw XML tool calls in the content field.
DYN_EXCLUDE_TOOLS_WHEN_TOOL_CHOICE_NONE.display_name: Dyn Exclude Tools When Tool Choice None

DYN_CUSTOM_JINJA_TEMPLATE.description: Path to a custom Jinja template file to override the model's default chat template. This template will take precedence over any template found in the model repository.

DYN_ENDPOINT_TYPES.description: Comma-separated list of endpoint types to enable. Options: 'chat', 'completions'. Use 'completions' for models without chat templates.

DYN_DUMP_CONFIG_TO.description: Dump resolved configuration to the specified file path.

DYN_MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_CACHE_CAPACITY_.description: Capacity of the multimodal embedding cache in GB. 0 = disabled.
DYN_MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_CACHE_CAPACITY_.display_name: Dyn Multimodal Embedding Cache Capacity Gb

DYN_OUTPUT_MODALITIES.description: Output modalities for omni/diffusion mode (e.g., --output-modalities text image audio video).

DYN_MEDIA_OUTPUT_FS_URL.description: Filesystem URL for storing generated images and videos (e.g. file:///tmp/dynamo_media, s3://bucket/path).

DYN_MEDIA_OUTPUT_HTTP_URL.description: Base URL for rewriting media file paths in responses (e.g. http://localhost:8000/media). If unset, returns raw filesystem paths.

DYN_VLLM_DISAGGREGATION_MODE.description: Worker disaggregation mode: 'agg' (default, aggregated), 'prefill' (prefill-only worker), or 'decode' (decode-only worker).

DYN_VLLM_IS_PREFILL_WORKER.description: DEPRECATED: use --disaggregation-mode=prefill. Enable prefill functionality for this worker.

DYN_VLLM_IS_DECODE_WORKER.description: DEPRECATED: use --disaggregation-mode=decode. Mark this as a decode worker which does not publish KV events.

DYN_VLLM_USE_TOKENIZER.description: Use vLLM's tokenizer for pre and post processing. This bypasses Dynamo's preprocessor and only v1/chat/completions will be available through the Dynamo frontend.

DYN_VLLM_ROUTE_TO_ENCODER.description: Enable routing to separate encoder workers for multimodal processing.

DYN_VLLM_MULTIMODAL_ENCODE_WORKER.description: Run as multimodal encode worker component for processing images/videos.

DYN_VLLM_MULTIMODAL_WORKER.description: Run as multimodal worker component for LLM inference with multimodal data.

DYN_VLLM_MULTIMODAL_DECODE_WORKER.description: Run as multimodal decode worker in disaggregated mode.

DYN_VLLM_ENABLE_MULTIMODAL.description: Enable multimodal processing. If not set, none of the multimodal components can be used.

DYN_VLLM_MM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.description:
Different multi-modal models expect the prompt to contain different special media prompts. The processor will use this argument to construct the final prompt. User prompt will replace '<prompt>' in the provided template. For example, if the user prompt is 'please describe the image' and the prompt template is 'USER: <image> <prompt> ASSISTANT:', the resulting prompt is 'USER: <image> please describe the image ASSISTANT:'.
<prompt> ASSISTANT:

DYN_VLLM_FRONTEND_DECODING.description: Enable frontend decoding of multimodal images. When enabled, images are decoded in the Rust frontend and transferred to the backend via NIXL RDMA. Without this flag, images are decoded in the Python backend (default behavior).

DYN_VLLM_HEADLESS.description: Run in headless mode for multi-node TP/PP. Secondary nodes run vLLM workers only, no dynamo endpoints. See vLLM multi-node data parallel documentation for more details.

MODEL_EXPRESS_URL.description: ModelExpress P2P server URL (e.g., http://mx-server:8080). Required when using --load-format=mx-source or --load-format=mx-target.

DYN_VLLM_GMS_SHADOW_MODE.description: Enable GMS shadow/standby mode. Shadow engines skip KV cache allocation at startup, automatically sleep after initialization, and wake on demand when the active engine dies. Requires --load-format=gms.

DYN_BENCHMARK_MODE.description: Run self-benchmark on startup before accepting requests. Sweeps prefill ISLs and/or decode (context_length x batch_size) points, collecting ForwardPassMetrics at each operating point.

DYN_BENCHMARK_PREFILL_GRANULARITY.description: Number of ISL sample points for prefill sweep (default: 16).

DYN_BENCHMARK_DECODE_LENGTH_GRANULARITY.description: Number of context length sample points for decode sweep (default: 6).

DYN_BENCHMARK_DECODE_BATCH_GRANULARITY.description: Number of batch size sample points per context length (default: 6).

DYN_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT_PATH.description: Path to write benchmark results JSON (default: /tmp/benchmark_results.json).

DYN_BENCHMARK_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum seconds to wait for benchmark to complete (default: 300). Worker startup fails if exceeded.

DYN_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS.display_name: Dyn Graceful Shutdown Grace Period Secs

DYN_OMNI_ENABLE_CACHE_DIT_SUMMARY.display_name: Dyn Omni Enable Cache Dit Summary

DYN_OMNI_LAYERWISE_NUM_GPU_LAYERS.display_name: Dyn Omni Layerwise Num GPU Layers

DYN_OMNI_TTS_MAX_INSTRUCTIONS_LENGTH.display_name: Dyn Omni Tts Max Instructions Length

DYN_OMNI_TTS_MAX_NEW_TOKENS_MAX.display_name: Dyn Omni Tts Max New Tokens Max

DYN_OMNI_TTS_MAX_NEW_TOKENS_MIN.display_name: Dyn Omni Tts Max New Tokens Min

DYN_OMNI_TTS_REF_AUDIO_MAX_BYTES.display_name: Dyn Omni Tts Ref Audio Max Bytes

DYN_OMNI_TTS_REF_AUDIO_TIMEOUT.display_name: Dyn Omni Tts Ref Audio Timeout

DYN_OMNI_VAE_PATCH_PARALLEL_SIZE.display_name: Dyn Omni Vae Patch Parallel Size

VLLM_MOONCAKE_BOOTSTRAP_PORT.description: Port used for Mooncake handshake between remote agents.

VLLM_KV_EVENTS_USE_INT_BLOCK_HASHES.description: Represent block hashes in KV cache events as 64-bit integers instead of raw bytes. Defaults to True for backward compatibility.
VLLM_KV_EVENTS_USE_INT_BLOCK_HASHES.display_name: vLLM KV Events Use Int Block Hashes

VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL.description: this is used for configuring the default logging level

VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S.description: Timeout in seconds for waiting for engine cores to become ready during startup. Default is 600 seconds (10 minutes).

VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Timeout in seconds for execute_model RPC calls in multiprocessing executor (only applies when TP > 1).

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE.description: Target device of vLLM, supporting [cuda (by default), rocm, cpu]

VLLM_MAIN_CUDA_VERSION.description: Main CUDA version of vLLM. This follows PyTorch but can be overridden.

VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION.description: Controls PyTorch float32 matmul precision mode within vLLM workers. Valid options mirror torch.set_float32_matmul_precision

VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT.description: Enable batch-invariant mode: deterministic results regardless of batch composition. Requires NVIDIA GPU with compute capability >= 9.0.

MAX_JOBS.description: Maximum number of compilation jobs to run in parallel. By default this is the number of CPUs

NVCC_THREADS.description: Number of threads to use for nvcc By default this is 1. If set, `MAX_JOBS` will be reduced to avoid oversubscribing the CPU.

VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED.description: If set, vllm will use precompiled binaries (*.so)

VLLM_SKIP_PRECOMPILED_VERSION_SUFFIX.description: If set, skip adding +precompiled suffix to version string

VLLM_DOCKER_BUILD_CONTEXT.description: Used to mark that setup.py is running in a Docker build context, in order to force the use of precompiled binaries.

CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE.description: CMake build type If not set, defaults to "Debug" or "RelWithDebInfo" Available options: "Debug", "Release", "RelWithDebInfo"

VERBOSE.description: If set, vllm will print verbose logs during installation

VLLM_CONFIG_ROOT.description: Root directory for vLLM configuration files Defaults to `~/.config/vllm` unless `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is set Note that this not only affects how vllm finds its configuration files during runtime, but also affects how vllm installs its configuration files during **installation**.

VLLM_CACHE_ROOT.description: Root directory for vLLM cache files Defaults to `~/.cache/vllm` unless `XDG_CACHE_HOME` is set

VLLM_HOST_IP.description: used in distributed environment to determine the ip address of the current node, when the node has multiple network interfaces. If you are using multi-node inference, you should set this differently on each node.

VLLM_PORT.description: used in distributed environment to manually set the communication port Note: if VLLM_PORT is set, and some code asks for multiple ports, the VLLM_PORT will be used as the first port, and the rest will be generated by incrementing the VLLM_PORT value.

VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH.description: path used for ipc when the frontend api server is running in multi-processing mode to communicate with the backend engine process.

VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE.description: If true, will load models from ModelScope instead of Hugging Face Hub. note that the value is true or false, not numbers

VLLM_RINGBUFFER_WARNING_INTERVAL.description: Interval in seconds to log a warning message when the ring buffer is full

CUDA_HOME.description: path to cudatoolkit home directory, under which should be bin, include, and lib directories.

VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH.description: Path to the NCCL library file. It is needed because nccl>=2.19 brought by PyTorch contains a bug: https://github.com/NVIDIA/nccl/issues/1234

LD_LIBRARY_PATH.description: when `VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH` is not set, vllm will try to find the nccl library file in the locations specified by `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`

VLLM_ROCM_SLEEP_MEM_CHUNK_SIZE.description: flag to control the chunk size (in MB) for sleeping memory allocations under ROCm
VLLM_ROCM_SLEEP_MEM_CHUNK_SIZE.display_name: vLLM Rocm Sleep Mem Chunk Size

VLLM_USE_STANDALONE_COMPILE.description: Feature flag to enable/disable Inductor standalone compile. In torch <= 2.7 we ignore this flag; in torch >= 2.9 this is enabled by default.

VLLM_ENABLE_PREGRAD_PASSES.description: Inductor's pre-grad passes don't do anything for vLLM. The pre-grad passes get run even on cache-hit and negatively impact vllm cold compile times by O(1s) Can remove this after the following issue gets fixed https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/174502

VLLM_PATTERN_MATCH_DEBUG.description: Debug pattern matching inside custom passes. Should be set to the fx.Node name (e.g. 'getitem_34' or 'scaled_mm_3').

VLLM_DEBUG_DUMP_PATH.description: Dump fx graphs to the given directory. It will override CompilationConfig.debug_dump_path if set.

VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE.description: Feature flag to enable/disable AOT compilation. This will ensure compilation is done in warmup phase and the compilation will be reused in subsequent calls.

VLLM_USE_BYTECODE_HOOK.description: Feature flag to enable/disable bytecode in TorchCompileWithNoGuardsWrapper.

VLLM_FORCE_AOT_LOAD.description: Force vllm to always load AOT compiled models from disk. Failure to load will result in a hard error when this is enabled. Will be ignored when VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE is disabled.

VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT.description: Enable loading compiled models directly from cached standalone compile artifacts without re-splitting graph modules. This reduces overhead during model loading by using reconstruct_serializable_fn_from_mega_artifact.

LOCAL_RANK.description: local rank of the process in the distributed setting, used to determine the GPU device id

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.description: used to control the visible devices in the distributed setting

VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S.description: timeout for each iteration in the engine

VLLM_API_KEY.description: API key for vLLM API server

VLLM_DEBUG_LOG_API_SERVER_RESPONSE.description: Whether to log responses from API Server for debugging
VLLM_DEBUG_LOG_API_SERVER_RESPONSE.display_name: vLLM Debug Log API Server Response

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access information, used for tensorizer to load model from S3

VLLM_CONFIGURE_LOGGING.description: Logging configuration If set to 0, vllm will not configure logging If set to 1, vllm will configure logging using the default configuration or the configuration file specified by VLLM_LOGGING_CONFIG_PATH

VLLM_LOGGING_STREAM.description: this is used for configuring the default logging stream

VLLM_LOGGING_PREFIX.description: if set, VLLM_LOGGING_PREFIX will be prepended to all log messages

VLLM_LOGGING_COLOR.description: Controls colored logging output. Options: "auto" (default, colors when terminal), "1" (always use colors), "0" (never use colors)

NO_COLOR.description: Standard unix flag for disabling ANSI color codes

VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL.description: If set, vllm will log stats at this interval in seconds If not set, vllm will log stats every 10 seconds.

VLLM_TRACE_FUNCTION.description: Trace function calls If set to 1, vllm will trace function calls Useful for debugging

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER.description: If set, vllm will use flashinfer sampler

VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE.description: (CPU backend only) CPU key-value cache space. default is None and will be set as 4 GB

VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND.description: (CPU backend only) CPU core ids bound by OpenMP threads, e.g., "0-31", "0,1,2", "0-31,33". CPU cores of different ranks are separated by '|'.

VLLM_CPU_NUM_OF_RESERVED_CPU.description: (CPU backend only) CPU cores not used by OMP threads . Those CPU cores will not be used by OMP threads of a rank.
VLLM_CPU_NUM_OF_RESERVED_CPU.display_name: vLLM CPU Num Of Reserved CPU

VLLM_CPU_SGL_KERNEL.description: (CPU backend only) whether to use SGL kernels, optimized for small batch.

VLLM_ZENTORCH_WEIGHT_PREPACK.description: (Zen CPU backend) eagerly prepack weights into ZenDNN blocked layout at model load time. Eliminates per-inference layout conversion overhead.

VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG_CHANNEL_TYPE.description: If the env var is set, Ray Compiled Graph uses the specified channel type to communicate between workers belonging to different pipeline-parallel stages. Available options: - "auto": use the default channel type - "nccl": use NCCL for communication - "shm": use shared memory and gRPC for communication
VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG_CHANNEL_TYPE.display_name: vLLM Use Ray Compiled Dag Channel Type

VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG_OVERLAP_COMM.description: If the env var is set, it enables GPU communication overlap (experimental feature) in Ray's Compiled Graph.
VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG_OVERLAP_COMM.display_name: vLLM Use Ray Compiled Dag Overlap Comm

VLLM_USE_RAY_WRAPPED_PP_COMM.description: If the env var is set, it uses a Ray Communicator wrapping vLLM's pipeline parallelism communicator to interact with Ray's Compiled Graph. Otherwise, it uses Ray's NCCL communicator.
VLLM_USE_RAY_WRAPPED_PP_COMM.display_name: vLLM Use Ray Wrapped Pp Comm

VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD.description: Use dedicated multiprocess context for workers. Both spawn and fork work

VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE.description: Path to the cache for storing downloaded assets

VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE_MODEL_CLEAN.description: If the env var is set, we will clean model file in this path $VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE/model_streamer/$model_name

VLLM_MEDIA_URL_ALLOW_REDIRECTS.description: Whether to allow HTTP redirects when fetching from media URLs. Default to True

VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_CLIP_FILESIZE_MB.description: Maximum filesize in MB for a single audio file when processing speech-to-text requests. Files larger than this will be rejected. Default is 25 MB
VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_CLIP_FILESIZE_MB.display_name: vLLM Max Audio Clip Filesize Mb

VLLM_VIDEO_LOADER_BACKEND.description: Backend for Video IO - "opencv": Default backend that uses OpenCV stream buffered backend. - "identity": Returns raw video bytes for model processor to handle.  Custom backend implementations can be registered via `@VIDEO_LOADER_REGISTRY.register("my_custom_video_loader")` and imported at runtime. If a non-existing backend is used, an AssertionError will be thrown.

VLLM_MEDIA_CONNECTOR.description: Media connector implementation. - "http": Default connector that supports fetching media via HTTP.  Custom implementations can be registered via `@MEDIA_CONNECTOR_REGISTRY.register("my_custom_media_connector")` and imported at runtime. If a non-existing backend is used, an AssertionError will be thrown.

VLLM_XLA_CACHE_PATH.description: Path to the XLA persistent cache directory. Only used for XLA devices such as TPUs.

VLLM_XLA_CHECK_RECOMPILATION.description: If set, assert on XLA recompilation after each execution step.

VLLM_XLA_USE_SPMD.description: Enable SPMD mode for TPU backend.

VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB.description: Maximum size (in MB) for logits tensor in sparse MLA indexer prefill chunks. Bounds the [M, N] float32 logits tensor to prevent CUDA OOM. Default: 512 MB
VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB.display_name: vLLM Sparse Indexer Max Logits Mb

VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH.description: If set, the OpenAI API server will stay alive even after the underlying AsyncLLMEngine errors and stops serving requests
VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH.display_name: vLLM Keep Alive On Engine Death

VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN.description: If the env var VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN is set, it allows the user to specify a max sequence length greater than the max length derived from the model's config.json. To enable this, set VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1.
VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN.display_name: vLLM Allow Long Max Model Len

VLLM_TEST_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN.description: If set, forces FP8 Marlin to be used for FP8 quantization regardless of the hardware support for FP8 compute.

VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT.description: Time in ms for the zmq client to wait for a response from the backend server for simple data operations

VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE.description: Timeout in seconds for keeping HTTP connections alive in API server

VLLM_MAX_N_SEQUENCES.description: Maximum allowed value for the `n` sampling parameter (number of output sequences per request). Limits resource consumption to prevent denial-of-service via excessively large fan-out. Default: 16384.

VLLM_PLUGINS.description: a list of plugin names to load, separated by commas. if this is not set, it means all plugins will be loaded if this is set to an empty string, no plugins will be loaded

VLLM_LORA_RESOLVER_CACHE_DIR.description: a local directory to look in for unrecognized LoRA adapters. only works if plugins are enabled and VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING is enabled.

VLLM_LORA_RESOLVER_HF_REPO_LIST.description: A remote HF repo(s) containing one or more LoRA adapters, which may be downloaded and leveraged as needed. Only works if plugins are enabled and VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING is enabled. Values should be comma separated.
VLLM_LORA_RESOLVER_HF_REPO_LIST.display_name: vLLM LoRA Resolver Hf Repo List

VLLM_USE_TRITON_AWQ.description: If set, vLLM will use Triton implementations of AWQ.

VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK.description: We assume drivers can report p2p status correctly. If the program hangs when using custom allreduce, potantially caused by a bug in the driver (535 series), if might be helpful to set VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK=0 so that vLLM can verify if p2p is actually working. See https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/a9b15c606fea67a072416ea0ea115261a2756058/vllm/distributed/device_communicators/custom_all_reduce_utils.py#L101-L108 for details. # noqa

VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS.description: List of quantization kernels that should be disabled, used for testing and performance comparisons. Currently only affects MPLinearKernel selection (kernels: MacheteLinearKernel, MarlinLinearKernel, ExllamaLinearKernel)

VLLM_ENABLE_FLA_PACKED_RECURRENT_DECODE.display_name: vLLM Enable Fla Packed Recurrent Decode

VLLM_USE_OINK_OPS.description: Optional: enable external Oink custom ops (e.g., Blackwell RMSNorm). Disabled by default.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER.description: Disable aiter ops unless specifically enabled. Acts as a parent switch to enable the rest of the other operations.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_PAGED_ATTN.description: Whether to use aiter paged attention. By default is disabled.
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_PAGED_ATTN.display_name: vLLM Rocm Use Aiter Paged Attn

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR.description: use aiter linear op if aiter ops are enabled The following list of related ops - scaled_mm (per-tensor / rowwise)

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE.description: Whether to use aiter moe ops. By default is enabled.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM.description: use aiter rms norm op if aiter ops are enabled.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA.description: Whether to use aiter mla ops. By default is enabled.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA.description: Whether to use aiter mha ops. By default is enabled.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM.description: Whether to use aiter fp4 gemm asm. By default is disabled.
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM.display_name: vLLM Rocm Use Aiter Fp4 Asm Gemm

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_ROPE.description: Whether to use aiter rope. By default is disabled.
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_ROPE.display_name: vLLM Rocm Use Aiter Triton Rope

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM.description: Whether to use aiter triton fp8 bmm kernel By default is enabled.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4BMM.description: Whether to use aiter triton fp4 bmm kernel By default is enabled.

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION.description: Use AITER triton unified attention for V1 attention
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION.display_name: vLLM Rocm Use Aiter Unified Attention

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERT.description: Whether to use aiter fusion shared experts ops. By default is disabled.
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERT.display_name: vLLM Rocm Use Aiter Fusion Shared Experts

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_GEMM.description: Whether to use aiter triton kernels for gemm ops. By default is enabled.
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_GEMM.display_name: vLLM Rocm Use Aiter Triton Gemm

VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING.description: Pad the fp8 weights to 256 bytes for ROCm

VLLM_ROCM_MOE_PADDING.description: Pad the weights for the moe kernel

VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.description: Whether to use the shuffled kv cache layout
VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.display_name: vLLM Rocm Shuffle KV Cache Layout

VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards Choice of quantization level: FP, INT8, INT6, INT4 or NONE Recommended for large models to get allreduce

VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards Due to the lack of the bfloat16 asm instruction, bfloat16 kernels are slower than fp16, If environment variable is set to 1, the input is converted to fp16
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16.display_name: vLLM Rocm Quick Reduce Cast Bf16 To Fp16

VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB.description: Custom quick allreduce kernel for MI3* cards. Controls the maximum allowed number of data bytes(MB) for custom quick allreduce communication. Default: 2048 MB. Data exceeding this size will use either custom allreduce or RCCL communication.
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB.display_name: vLLM Rocm Quick Reduce Max Size Bytes Mb

Q_SCALE_CONSTANT.description: Divisor for dynamic query scale factor calculation for FP8 KV Cache

K_SCALE_CONSTANT.description: Divisor for dynamic key scale factor calculation for FP8 KV Cache

V_SCALE_CONSTANT.description: Divisor for dynamic value scale factor calculation for FP8 KV Cache

VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING.description: If set, enable multiprocessing in LLM for the V1 code path.

VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE.description: If set, vllm will run in development mode, which will enable some additional endpoints for developing and debugging, e.g. `/reset_prefix_cache`

VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE.description: Controls the maximum number of requests to handle in a single asyncio task when processing per-token outputs in the V1 AsyncLLM interface. It is applicable when handling a high concurrency of streaming requests. Setting this too high can result in a higher variance of inter-message latencies. Setting it too low can negatively impact TTFT and overall throughput.
VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE.display_name: vLLM V1 Output Proc Chunk Size

VLLM_MLA_DISABLE.description: If set, vLLM will disable the MLA attention optimizations.

VLLM_RAY_PER_WORKER_GPUS.description: If set, vLLM will pick up the provided Flash Attention MLA Number of GPUs per worker in Ray, if it is set to be a fraction, it allows ray to schedule multiple actors on a single GPU, so that users can colocate other actors on the same GPUs as vLLM.

VLLM_RAY_BUNDLE_INDICES.description: Bundle indices for Ray, if it is set, it can control precisely which indices are used for the Ray bundle, for every worker. Format: comma-separated list of integers, e.g. "0,1,2,3"

VLLM_CUDART_SO_PATH.description: In some system, find_loaded_library() may not work. So we allow users to specify the path through environment variable VLLM_CUDART_SO_PATH.

VLLM_DP_RANK.description: Rank of the process in the data parallel setting

VLLM_DP_RANK_LOCAL.description: Rank of the process in the data parallel setting. Defaults to VLLM_DP_RANK when not set.

VLLM_DP_SIZE.description: World size of the data parallel setting

VLLM_DP_MASTER_IP.description: IP address of the master node in the data parallel setting

VLLM_DP_MASTER_PORT.description: Port of the master node in the data parallel setting

VLLM_MOE_DP_CHUNK_SIZE.description: In the context of executing MoE models with Data-Parallel, Expert-Parallel and Batched All-to-All dispatch/combine kernels, VLLM_MOE_DP_CHUNK_SIZE dictates the quantum of tokens that can be dispatched from a DP rank. All DP ranks process the activations in VLLM_MOE_DP_CHUNK_SIZE units.

VLLM_RANDOMIZE_DP_DUMMY_INPUTS.description: Randomize inputs during dummy runs when using Data Parallel

VLLM_RAY_DP_PACK_STRATEGY.description: Strategy to pack the data parallel ranks for Ray. Available options: - "fill": for DP master node, allocate exactly data-parallel-size-local DP ranks, for non-master nodes, allocate as many DP ranks as can fit; - "strict": allocate exactly data-parallel-size-local DP ranks to each picked node; - "span": Should be used only when a single DP rank requires multiple nodes. allocate one DP rank over as many nodes as required for set world_size; This environment variable is ignored if data-parallel-backend is not Ray.

VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VAR_PREFIXES_TO_COPY.description: Comma-separated *additional* prefixes of env vars to copy from the driver to Ray workers.  These are merged with the built-in defaults defined in ``vllm.ray.ray_env`` (VLLM_, etc.).  Example: "MYLIB_,OTHER_"
VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VAR_PREFIXES_TO_COPY.display_name: vLLM Ray Extra Env Var Prefixes To Copy

VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VARS_TO_COPY.description: Comma-separated *additional* individual env var names to copy from the driver to Ray workers.  Merged with the built-in defaults defined in ``vllm.ray.ray_env`` (PYTHONHASHSEED). Example: "MY_SECRET,MY_FLAG"
VLLM_RAY_EXTRA_ENV_VARS_TO_COPY.display_name: vLLM Ray Extra Env Vars To Copy

VLLM_CI_USE_S3.description: Whether to use S3 path for model loading in CI via RunAI Streamer

VLLM_MODEL_REDIRECT_PATH.description: Use model_redirect to redirect the model name to a local folder. `model_redirect` can be a json file mapping the model between repo_id and local folder: {"meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B": "/tmp/Llama-3.2-1B"} or a space separated values table file: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B   /tmp/Llama-3.2-1B

VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD.description: Whether to use atomicAdd reduce in gptq/awq marlin kernel.

VLLM_MXFP4_USE_MARLIN.description: Whether to use marlin kernel in mxfp4 quantization method

VLLM_MARLIN_INPUT_DTYPE.description: The activation dtype for marlin kernel

VLLM_DEEPEPLL_NVFP4_DISPATCH.description: Whether to use DeepEPLL kernels for NVFP4 quantization and dispatch method only supported on Blackwell GPUs and with https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/pull/341

VLLM_V1_USE_OUTLINES_CACHE.description: Whether to turn on the outlines cache for V1 This cache is unbounded and on disk, so it's not safe to use in an environment with potentially malicious users.

VLLM_TPU_BUCKET_PADDING_GAP.description: Gap between padding buckets for the forward pass. So we have 8, we will run forward pass with [16, 24, 32, ...].

VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM.description: Allow use of DeepGemm kernels for fused moe ops.

VLLM_MOE_USE_DEEP_GEMM.description: Allow use of DeepGemm specifically for MoE fused ops (overrides only MoE).

VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM_E8M0.description: Whether to use E8M0 scaling when DeepGEMM is used on Blackwell GPUs.

VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM_TMA_ALIGNED_SCALES.description: Whether to create TMA-aligned scale tensor when DeepGEMM is used.
VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM_TMA_ALIGNED_SCALES.display_name: vLLM Use Deep Gemm Tma Aligned Scales

VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP.description: DeepGemm JITs the kernels on-demand. The warmup attempts to make DeepGemm JIT all the required kernels before model execution so there is no JIT'ing in the hot-path. However, this warmup increases the engine startup time by a couple of minutes. Available options: - "skip"  : Skip warmup. - "full"  : Warmup deepgemm by running all possible gemm shapes the engine could encounter. - "relax" : Select gemm shapes to run based on some heuristics. The heuristic aims to have the same effect as running all possible gemm shapes, but provides no guarantees.

VLLM_USE_FUSED_MOE_GROUPED_TOPK.description: Whether to use fused grouped_topk used for MoE expert selection.
VLLM_USE_FUSED_MOE_GROUPED_TOPK.display_name: vLLM Use Fused Moe Grouped Topk

VLLM_BLOCKSCALE_FP8_GEMM_FLASHINFER.description: Allow use of FlashInfer FP8 block-scale GEMM for linear layers. This uses TensorRT-LLM kernels and requires SM90+ (Hopper).

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP16.description: Allow use of FlashInfer BF16 MoE kernels for fused moe ops.

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP8.description: Allow use of FlashInfer FP8 MoE kernels for fused moe ops.

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4.description: Allow use of FlashInfer NVFP4 MoE kernels for fused moe ops.

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_INT4.description: Allow use of FlashInfer MxInt4 MoE kernels for fused moe ops.

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_MXFP8.description: If set to 1, use the FlashInfer MXFP8 (activation) x MXFP4 (weight) MoE backend.
VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_MXFP8.display_name: vLLM Use Flashinfer Moe Mxfp4 Mxfp8

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_MXFP8_CUTL.description: If set to 1, use the FlashInfer CUTLASS backend for MXFP8 (activation) x MXFP4 (weight) MoE. This is separate from the TRTLLMGEN path controlled by VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_MXFP8.
VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_MXFP8_CUTL.display_name: vLLM Use Flashinfer Moe Mxfp4 Mxfp8 Cutlass

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_BF16.description: If set to 1, use the FlashInfer BF16 (activation) x MXFP4 (weight) MoE backend.
VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_MXFP4_BF16.display_name: vLLM Use Flashinfer Moe Mxfp4 Bf16

VLLM_XGRAMMAR_CACHE_MB.description: Control the cache sized used by the xgrammar compiler. The default of 512 MB should be enough for roughly 1000 JSON schemas. It can be changed with this variable if needed for some reason.

VLLM_MSGPACK_ZERO_COPY_THRESHOLD.description: Control the threshold for msgspec to use 'zero copy' for serialization/deserialization of tensors. Tensors below this limit will be encoded into the msgpack buffer, and tensors above will instead be sent via a separate message. While the sending side still actually copies the tensor in all cases, on the receiving side, tensors above this limit will actually be zero-copy decoded.

VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION.description: If set, allow insecure serialization using pickle. This is useful for environments where it is deemed safe to use the insecure method and it is needed for some reason.

VLLM_DISABLE_REQUEST_ID_RANDOMIZATION.description: Temporary: skip adding random suffix to internal request IDs. May be needed for KV connectors that match request IDs across instances.

VLLM_FLASHINFER_MOE_BACKEND.description: Flashinfer MoE backend for vLLM's fused Mixture-of-Experts support. Both require compute capability 10.0 or above. Available options: - "throughput":  [default] Uses CUTLASS kernels optimized for high-throughput batch inference. - "latency": Uses TensorRT-LLM kernels optimized for low-latency inference.

VLLM_FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Control the workspace buffer size for the FlashInfer backend.

VLLM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_EXPERT_FP4_MOE.description: Control the maximum number of tokens per expert supported by the NVFP4 MoE CUTLASS Kernel. This value is used to create a buffer for the blockscale tensor of activations NVFP4 Quantization. This is used to prevent the kernel from running out of memory.
VLLM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_EXPERT_FP4_MOE.display_name: vLLM Max Tokens Per Expert Fp4 Moe

VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_FUSION_THRESHO.description: Specifies the thresholds of the communicated tensor sizes under which vllm should use flashinfer fused allreduce. The variable should be a JSON with the following format: { <world size>: <max size in mb> } Unspecified world sizes will fall back to { 2: 64, 4: 1, <everything else>: 0.5 }
VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_FUSION_THRESHO.display_name: vLLM Flashinfer Allreduce Fusion Thresholds Mb

VLLM_MOE_ROUTING_SIMULATION_STRATEGY.description: MoE routing strategy selector. See `RoutingSimulator.get_available_strategies()` # for available strategies. Custom routing strategies can be registered by RoutingSimulator.register_strategy() Note: custom strategies may not produce correct model outputs

VLLM_TOOL_PARSE_REGEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Regex timeout for use by the vLLM tool parsing plugins.
VLLM_TOOL_PARSE_REGEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.display_name: vLLM Tool Parse Regex Timeout Seconds

VLLM_MQ_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES_MB.description: Control the max chunk bytes (in MB) for the rpc message queue. Object larger than this threshold will be broadcast to worker processes via zmq.
VLLM_MQ_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES_MB.display_name: vLLM Mq Max Chunk Bytes Mb

VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.description: KV Cache layout used throughout vllm. Some common values are: - NHD - HND Where N=num_blocks, H=num_heads and D=head_size. The default value will leave the layout choice to the backend. Mind that backends may only implement and support a subset of all possible layouts.

VLLM_COMPUTE_NANS_IN_LOGITS.description: Enable checking whether the generated logits contain NaNs, indicating corrupted output. Useful for debugging low level bugs or bad hardware but it may add compute overhead.

VLLM_USE_NVFP4_CT_EMULATIONS.description: Controls whether or not emulations are used for NVFP4 generations on machines < 100 for compressed-tensors models

VLLM_NIXL_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Time (in seconds) after which the KV cache on the producer side is automatically cleared if no READ notification is received from the consumer. This is only applicable when using NixlConnector in a disaggregated decode-prefill setup.

VLLM_MORIIO_CONNECTOR_READ_MODE.description: Controls the read mode for the Mori-IO connector

VLLM_MORIIO_QP_PER_TRANSFER.description: Controls the QP (Queue Pair) per transfer configuration for the Mori-IO connector

VLLM_MORIIO_POST_BATCH_SIZE.description: Controls the post-processing batch size for the Mori-IO connector

VLLM_MORIIO_NUM_WORKERS.description: Controls the number of workers for Mori operations for the Mori-IO connector

VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout (in seconds) for MooncakeConnector in PD disaggregated setup.

VLLM_HAS_FLASHINFER_CUBIN.description: If set, it means we pre-downloaded cubin files and flashinfer will read the cubin files directly.

VLLM_NVFP4_GEMM_BACKEND.description: Supported options: - "flashinfer-cudnn": use flashinfer cudnn GEMM backend - "flashinfer-trtllm": use flashinfer trtllm GEMM backend - "flashinfer-cutlass": use flashinfer cutlass GEMM backend - "marlin": use marlin GEMM backend (for GPUs without native FP4 support) - <none>: automatically pick an available backend

VLLM_ENABLE_CUDAGRAPH_GC.description: Controls garbage collection during CUDA graph capture. If set to 0 (default), enables GC freezing to speed up capture time. If set to 1, allows GC to run during capture.

VLLM_LOOPBACK_IP.description: Used to force set up loopback IP

VLLM_PROCESS_NAME_PREFIX.description: Used to set the process name prefix for vLLM processes. This is useful for debugging and monitoring purposes. The default value is "VLLM".

VLLM_ALLOW_CHUNKED_LOCAL_ATTN_WITH_HYBRI.description: Allow chunked local attention with hybrid kv cache manager. Currently using the Hybrid KV cache manager with chunked local attention in the Llama4 models (the only models currently using chunked local attn) causes a latency regression. For this reason, we disable it by default. This flag is used to allow users to enable it if they want to (to save on kv-cache memory usage and enable longer contexts) TODO(lucas): Remove this flag once latency regression is resolved.
VLLM_ALLOW_CHUNKED_LOCAL_ATTN_WITH_HYBRI.display_name: vLLM Allow Chunked Local Attn With Hybrid KV Cache

VLLM_ENABLE_RESPONSES_API_STORE.description: Enables support for the "store" option in the OpenAI Responses API. When set to 1, vLLM's OpenAI server will retain the input and output messages for those requests in memory. By default, this is disabled (0), and the "store" option is ignored. NOTE/WARNING: 1. Messages are kept in memory only (not persisted to disk) and will be lost when the vLLM server shuts down. 2. Enabling this option will cause a memory leak, as stored messages are never removed from memory until the server terminates.

VLLM_ROCM_FP8_MFMA_PAGE_ATTN.description: If set, use the fp8 mfma in rocm paged attention.
VLLM_ROCM_FP8_MFMA_PAGE_ATTN.display_name: vLLM Rocm Fp8 Mfma Page Attn

VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM.description: Whether to use pytorch symmetric memory for allreduce

VLLM_USE_EXPERIMENTAL_PARSER_CONTEXT.description: Experimental: use this to enable MCP tool calling for non harmony models

VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER.description: Allows vllm to find tuned config under customized folder

VLLM_GPT_OSS_SYSTEM_TOOL_MCP_LABELS.description: Valid values are container,code_interpreter,web_search_preview ex VLLM_GPT_OSS_SYSTEM_TOOL_MCP_LABELS=container,code_interpreter If the server_label of your mcp tool is not in this list it will be completely ignored.
VLLM_GPT_OSS_SYSTEM_TOOL_MCP_LABELS.display_name: vLLM Gpt Oss System Tool Mcp Labels

VLLM_GPT_OSS_HARMONY_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS.description: Allows harmony instructions to be injected on system messages
VLLM_GPT_OSS_HARMONY_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS.display_name: vLLM Gpt Oss Harmony System Instructions

VLLM_SYSTEM_START_DATE.description: Pin the conversation start date injected into the Harmony system message. When unset the current date is used, which introduces non-determinism (different tokens -> different model behaviour at temperature=0). Set to an ISO date string, e.g. "2023-09-12", for reproducible inference or testing.

VLLM_TOOL_JSON_ERROR_AUTOMATIC_RETRY.description: Enable automatic retry when tool call JSON parsing fails If enabled, returns an error message to the model to retry If disabled (default), raises an exception and fails the request
VLLM_TOOL_JSON_ERROR_AUTOMATIC_RETRY.display_name: vLLM Tool Json Error Automatic Retry

VLLM_CUSTOM_SCOPES_FOR_PROFILING.description: Add optional custom scopes for profiling, disable to avoid overheads

VLLM_NVTX_SCOPES_FOR_PROFILING.description: Add optional nvtx scopes for profiling, disable to avoid overheads

VLLM_OBJECT_STORAGE_SHM_BUFFER_NAME.description: Name of the shared memory buffer used for object storage. Only effective when mm_config.mm_processor_cache_type == "shm". Automatically generates a unique UUID-based name per process tree if not explicitly set.
VLLM_OBJECT_STORAGE_SHM_BUFFER_NAME.display_name: vLLM Object Storage Shm Buffer Name

VLLM_DEEPEP_BUFFER_SIZE_MB.description: The size in MB of the buffers (NVL and RDMA) used by DeepEP

VLLM_DEEPEP_HIGH_THROUGHPUT_FORCE_INTRA_.description: Force DeepEP to use intranode kernel for inter-node communication in high throughput mode. This is useful archive higher prefill throughput on system supports multi-node nvlink (e.g GB200).
VLLM_DEEPEP_HIGH_THROUGHPUT_FORCE_INTRA_.display_name: vLLM Deepep High Throughput Force Intra Node

VLLM_DEEPEP_LOW_LATENCY_USE_MNNVL.description: Allow DeepEP to use MNNVL (multi-node nvlink) for internode_ll kernel, turn this for better latency on GB200 like system
VLLM_DEEPEP_LOW_LATENCY_USE_MNNVL.display_name: vLLM Deepep Low Latency Use Mnnvl

VLLM_DBO_COMM_SMS.description: The number of SMs to allocate for communication kernels when running DBO the rest of the SMs on the device will be allocated to compute

VLLM_ENABLE_INDUCTOR_MAX_AUTOTUNE.description: Enable max_autotune & coordinate_descent_tuning in inductor_config to compile static shapes passed from compile_sizes in compilation_config If set to 1, enable max_autotune; By default, this is enabled (1)

VLLM_ENABLE_INDUCTOR_COORDINATE_DESCENT_.description: If set to 1, enable coordinate_descent_tuning; By default, this is enabled (1)
VLLM_ENABLE_INDUCTOR_COORDINATE_DESCENT_.display_name: vLLM Enable Inductor Coordinate Descent Tuning

VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM.description: Flag to enable NCCL symmetric memory allocation and registration

VLLM_USE_FBGEMM.description: Flag to enable FBGemm kernels on model execution

VLLM_GC_DEBUG.description: GC debug config - VLLM_GC_DEBUG=0: disable GC debugger - VLLM_GC_DEBUG=1: enable GC debugger with gc.collect elpased times - VLLM_GC_DEBUG='{"top_objects":5}': enable GC debugger with top 5 collected objects

VLLM_DEBUG_WORKSPACE.description: Debug workspace allocations. logging of workspace resize operations.

VLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM.description: Disables parallel execution of shared_experts via separate cuda stream

VLLM_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHO.description: Limits when we run shared_experts in a separate stream. We found out that for large batch sizes, the separate stream execution is not beneficial (most likely because of the input clone) TODO(alexm-redhat): Tune to be more dynamic based on GPU type
VLLM_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHO.display_name: vLLM Shared Experts Stream Token Threshold

VLLM_COMPILE_CACHE_SAVE_FORMAT.description: Format for saving torch.compile cache artifacts - "binary": saves as binary file Safe for multiple vllm serve processes accessing the same torch compile cache. - "unpacked": saves as directory structure (for inspection/debugging) NOT multiprocess safe - race conditions may occur with multiple processes. Allows viewing and setting breakpoints in Inductor's code output files.

VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER.description: Flag to enable v2 model runner.

VLLM_LOG_MODEL_INSPECTION.description: Log model inspection after loading. If enabled, logs a transformers-style hierarchical view of the model with quantization methods and attention backends.

VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_PIN_MEMOR.description: Disable using pytorch's pin memory for CPU offloading.
VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_PIN_MEMOR.display_name: vLLM Weight Offloading Disable Pin Memory

VLLM_WEIGHT_OFFLOADING_DISABLE_UVA.description: Disable using UVA (Unified Virtual Addressing) for CPU offloading.

VLLM_DISABLE_LOG_LOGO.description: Disable logging of vLLM logo at server startup time.

VLLM_LORA_DISABLE_PDL.description: Disable PDL for LoRA, as enabling PDL with LoRA on SM100 causes Triton compilation to fail.

VLLM_ENABLE_CUDA_COMPATIBILITY.description: Enable CUDA compatibility mode for datacenter GPUs with older driver versions than the CUDA toolkit major version of vLLM.

VLLM_CUDA_COMPATIBILITY_PATH.description: Path to the CUDA compatibility libraries when CUDA compatibility is enabled.

VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH.description: Whether it is a scale up launch engine for elastic EP, Should only be set by EngineCoreClient.
VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH.display_name: vLLM Elastic Ep Scale Up Launch

VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_DRAIN_REQUESTS.description: Whether to wait for all requests to drain before sending the scaling command in elastic EP.

VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS.description: If set to 1, enable CUDA graph memory estimation during memory profiling. This profiles CUDA graph memory usage to provide more accurate KV cache memory allocation. Disabled by default to preserve existing behavior.

VLLM_NIXL_EP_MAX_NUM_RANKS.display_name: vLLM NIXL Ep Max Num Ranks

VLLM_XPU_ENABLE_XPU_GRAPH.description: Whether enable XPU graph on Intel GPU
